shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone slab/block
a horizontal band of repeated pattern
justification: Both are stone reliefs whose figures are rendered in strict profile with incised linear detail, and each includes a horizontal band of repeated marks and a raised rectangular framing edge, which is about the extent of the correspondence. A is dominated by one tall, finely modelled human figure with drapery and a staff filling the whole field, whereas B stacks crude, blocky animal forms in several registers on a rough-surfaced pillar, so the compositional logic and level of finish are quite different.
